title: Joda-Time distances between leap-year MonthDay values
summary: Resolving partial dates against a nonleap reference year loses leap day or throws while converting it.

change.description: Resolving partial dates against a nonleap reference year loses leap day or throws while converting it.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 25 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 9 for normal, 17 for days, 0 for reversal. fix mismatches were 0 for normal, 0 for days, 0 for reversal.
